title: Longest subarray with at most 2 distinct values
statement_markdown: You have an array `fruits` where `fruits[i]` is the type of fruit the `i`-th tree produces. Return the maximum length of a contiguous subarray that contains at most 2 distinct types of fruits.

examples.explanation: We can pick from all 3 trees.

hints: Use sliding window and a hash map for counts.
explanation: Use a sliding window. Add fruits to the window and maintain their counts in a hash map. If the hash map size exceeds 2, shrink the window from the left until it is 2 again.
complexity: O(n) time and O(1) space (at most 3 elements in map).
